controls.reason: Every finding marked fixed can be joined to a successful retest bound to the fix and current artifact.

controls.reason: Relevance, blocker status, exposure, mitigation, and convincing demonstration require accountable security judgment; therefore the complete rule cannot receive a judgment-free deterministic Pass.

controls.reason: Deployed evidence is observable, but validating compensating-control effectiveness needs a control-specific protocol; therefore the complete rule cannot receive a judgment-free deterministic Pass.
Patch-path records and tests are checkable, but safe emergency operation requires contextual risk review; therefore the complete rule cannot receive a judgment-free deterministic Pass.

controls.reason: The policy is a record-presence fact, but channel existence is an effective endpoint fact and therefore requires a bounded read-only environment query.

Every reporting channel in the sealed vulnerability-reporting inventory resolves to the declared live endpoint and returns the independently sealed expected non-mutating availability response.

controls.counterexample_analysis: A policy record can list a reporting URL whose endpoint is dead or points elsewhere. The old structured-record-only clause could Pass; the environment clause fails that channel.

controls.reason: Appropriate acknowledgment, triage, disclosure, remediation, and credit processes depend on report and policy context; therefore the complete rule cannot receive a judgment-free deterministic Pass.
Can be produced promptly lacks advisory content, authority, trigger, and time objective; therefore the complete rule cannot receive a judgment-free deterministic Pass.
`Security evidence` and which evidence applies to a release are undefined, so retaining one authenticated record can pass while material evidence is missing.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A release retains a source scan but omits its penetration-test results, threat-model approval, and exception records. The generic evidence link passes because no complete applicable evidence taxonomy or aggregation is specified.

controls.reason: Regression test links are objective, but where practical and adequate representation require engineering judgment; therefore the complete rule cannot receive a judgment-free deterministic Pass.

controls.reason: A versioned plan and policy-defined freshness timestamp exactly decide whether a current incident-response plan exists.

controls.counterexample_analysis: I tried labels with no criteria, missing active severity, and a stale matrix. Schema and freshness checks fail each; quality is not asserted.

controls.reason: The word clear is made objective by requiring a complete sealed incident matrix and exactly one authorized declaring role or ordered delegation path for each case.

deterministic_clauses.statement: For each incident type and severity in the approved matrix, the incident plan identifies exactly one declaring authority or an unambiguous ordered delegation path.

controls.counterexample_analysis: A plan that lists several teams as possible declarers with no priority could look documented while responders still do not know who may declare. The uniqueness or ordered-delegation predicate rejects that ambiguity.

controls.reason: Named role assignments are checkable, but as-needed applicability and sufficient coverage require organizational judgment; therefore the complete rule cannot receive a judgment-free deterministic Pass.

controls.counterexample_analysis: An authenticated record can list primary and alternate channel identifiers while one endpoint is dead or both identifiers resolve to the same unavailable channel. Direct environment evidence fails.

controls.reason: Freshness plus access exercises under identity, network, and provider failures directly test the complete stated availability conditions.

controls.counterexample_analysis: I tried one generic procedure, security and privacy merged without distinction, and omitted fraud. Required branch schema fails each.

controls.reason: Blameless but accountable review quality is an organizational and cultural judgment; therefore the complete rule cannot receive a judgment-free deterministic Pass.
